```{r, include=FALSE}
#Ripple API
convert_to_dataframe <- function(resp_body_string, content_type) {
  if (content_type == "text/csv") {
    # Use read_csv from readr to read the CSV string directly into a data frame
    df <- readr::read_csv(response_body_string)
  } else if (content_type == "text/plain") {
    # Split the plain text by lines and then by commas (or other delimiters)
    lines <- strsplit(resp_body_string, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    data <- lapply(lines, function(line) {
      strsplit(line, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    })
    
       df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, data), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df) <- c("Column1", "Column2", "statusId")  # Replace with appropriate column names
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported content type")
  }
  
  return(df)
}

#Global
request<- request("https://echocharm.ripplescience.com")%>%
  req_url_path("/v1/export")%>%
  req_headers( "Content-Type" = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",  "Authorization" = "Basic dmFudHViZTRAbXN1LmVkdTpBQyR2dDEwNDEyMjMwMjQxMDQx")%>%
  req_body_form(
  export_type = "global",
  globalId = "globalId",
  firstName="firstName",
  lastName="lastName",
  sex="sex",
  birthday="birthday",
  #"Participant Contacts"=""
  )%>%
  req_method("GET")

response <- tryCatch(
 req_perform(request),

   message("Request failed: ", e)
   NULL
  }
)

 if (!is.null(response)) {
   data<- resp_body_string(response)

}

response_body_string <- resp_body_string(response)
content_type<-"text/csv"
study_global <- convert_to_dataframe(resp_body_string, content_type)
```

## Prenatal Overview {style="color: Teal"}

##### Below is a table of the number of enrollments completed so far by month. {style="color: Black"}

```{r, echo = FALSE}

# -------------- Prep report for Prenatal Basics: # of Enrollments completed, Enrollment Completed Date, Site completing enrollment

prenatal_2026_enroll <- prenatal_2026 %>%
  select(globalId, customId, statusId, consent_date) %>%
  mutate(site = case_when(
            str_starts(globalId, "41") | str_starts(globalId, "42") ~ "Detroit",
            str_starts(globalId, "44") | str_starts(globalId, "45") ~ "Flint",
            str_starts(globalId, "47") | str_starts(globalId, "48") ~ "Traverse City",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(year(consent_date) == 2026) %>%
  select(globalId, customId, statusId, consent_date, site)

# ----------------- Created for Enrollment Table
prenatal_enrollment_month <- prenatal_2026_enroll %>%
  mutate(month = month(consent_date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    Detroit = sum(site == "Detroit", na.rm = TRUE),
    Flint = sum(site == "Flint", na.rm = TRUE),
    Traverse_City = sum(site == "Traverse City", na.rm = TRUE),
    Total = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prenatal_enrollment_month %>%
  kable(format = "html", caption = "Total Enrollments by Month", booktabs = TRUE, col.names = c("Enrollment Month", "Detroit", "Flint", "Traverse City", "Total")) %>% 
  row_spec(row = 0, font_size = 16)%>%
  column_spec(column = c(1:5), width = "25in") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = F,  position = "float_right", font_size = 16)%>%
  gsub("font-size: initial !important;",
"font-size: 20pt !important;",
.)
```

### QA / QC for Date of Birth {style="color: Black"}

##### Below you will find a QA/QC Report done to verify all births are accounted for in Ripple and Participant Registration. Please note, items will only appear if a problem is found. Therefore, the report may sometimes show one table but can show up to three tables, depending on the warnings detected.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# -------------- Prepare table for comparing estimated due dates, dobs, and who to follow up with. 

prenatal_2026_eddvdob <- prenatal_2026 %>%
  select(globalId, customId, statusId, estduedate, child_dob) %>%
  mutate(site = case_when(
            str_starts(globalId, "41") | str_starts(globalId, "42") ~ "Detroit",
            str_starts(globalId, "44") | str_starts(globalId, "45") ~ "Flint",
            str_starts(globalId, "47") | str_starts(globalId, "48") ~ "Traverse City",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!statusId %in% c("0-5 Month Complete", "0-5 Month Detroit", "0-5 Month Traverse City", "0-5 Month Flint", "Pregnancy Loss")) %>%
  mutate(past_edd = if_else(estduedate < Sys.Date() & is.na(child_dob), "Check for DOB", NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(past_edd == "Check for DOB") %>%
  select(customId, site, estduedate)

# -------------- Prepare table for comparing DOB in Ripple with who is registered in Participant Registration.

PR <- read.csv("Z:/ECHO/CHARM/Data/Reports/2026/Prenatal Report/CSVs/PR_06222026.csv")

pr_prenatal <- PR %>%
  select(CohortParticipantId, EWCP_ParticipantID, Cycle2ProtocolEnrollmentDatev3_01) %>%
  rename("customId" = "CohortParticipantId",
         "globalId" = "EWCP_ParticipantID",
         "enrollmentDate" = "Cycle2ProtocolEnrollmentDatev3_01") %>%
  mutate(TFD = case_when(
    str_detect(customId, "F") ~ "TFD",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(TFD == "TFD") %>%
  select(customId, enrollmentDate)

ripple_prenatal <- study_prenatal %>%
  select(customId) %>%
  mutate(TFD = case_when(
    str_starts(customId, "4") ~ "TFD",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(TFD == "TFD") %>%
  select(customId)

missing_pr <- ripple_prenatal %>%
  anti_join(pr_prenatal, by = "customId")

missing_ripple <- pr_prenatal %>%
  anti_join(ripple_prenatal, by = "customId")
# ----------------- Created for Births Table

prenatal_2026_eddvdob %>%
  kable(format = "html", caption = "Estimated Due Date Past with No Date of Birth Recorded in Ripple Database", booktabs = TRUE, col.names = c("Custom ID", "Site", "Estimated Due Date")) %>% 
  row_spec(row = 0, font_size = 16)%>%
  column_spec(column = c(1:3), width = "12in") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = F,  position = "float_right", font_size = 16)%>%
  gsub("font-size: initial !important;", "font-size: 20pt !important;",.)

if (nrow(missing_pr) > 0) {
  missing_pr %>%
    select(customId) %>%
    kable(format = "html", caption = "Births Missing in Participant Registration but Present in Ripple Database", booktabs = TRUE, col.names = "Custom ID") %>%
    row_spec(0, font_size = 16) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "12in") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE, position = "float_right", font_size = 16) %>%
  gsub("font-size: initial !important;",
          "font-size: 20pt !important;",
.)}

if (nrow(missing_ripple) > 0) {
  missing_ripple %>%
    select(customId) %>%
    kable(format = "html", caption = "Births Missing in Ripple Database but Present in Participant Registration", booktabs = TRUE, col.names = "Custom ID") %>%
    row_spec(0, font_size = 16) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "12in") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", position = "float_right", full_width = FALSE, font_size = 16) %>%
     gsub("font-size: initial !important;",
          "font-size: 20pt !important;",.)}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
study_0to5 <- study_prenatal %>%

  rename("visit_scheduled" = "event.0_5_month_visit_scheduled.completedDate",
         "vib_request" = "event.vib_request_submitted.completedDate",

   mutate(visit_scheduled = as.Date(visit_scheduled, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
prenatal_biospecimens <- study_prenatal %>%
  select(customId, globalId, `event.first_prenatal_urine.completedDate`, `event.first_prenatal_blood.completedDate`, `event.household_water.completedDate`, `event.second_prenatal_urine.completedDate`, `event.second_prenatal_blood.completedDate`, `event.cord_blood_collection.completedDate`, `event.child_urine.completedDate`, `event.child_stool.completedDate`, `event.maternal_hair.completedDate`, `event.maternal_bloodspot.completedDate`, `event.breast_milk.completedDate`) %>%
  rename("pn1_urine" = "event.first_prenatal_urine.completedDate",
         "pn1_blood" = "event.first_prenatal_blood.completedDate",
         "pn2_urine" = "event.second_prenatal_urine.completedDate",
         "pn2_blood" = "event.second_prenatal_blood.completedDate",
         "water" = "event.household_water.completedDate",
         "child_urine" = "event.child_urine.completedDate",
         "child_stool" = "event.child_stool.completedDate",
         "mom_hair" = "event.maternal_hair.completedDate",
         "mom_bs" = "event.maternal_bloodspot.completedDate",
         "breast_milk" = "event.breast_milk.completedDate") %>%
  mutate(pn1_urine = as.Date(pn1_urine, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         pn1_blood = as.Date(pn1_blood, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         pn2_urine = as.Date(pn2_urine, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         pn2_blood = as.Date(pn1_blood, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         water = as.Date(water, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         child_urine = as.Date(child_urine, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         child_stool = as.Date(child_stool, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         mom_hair = as.Date(mom_hair, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         mom_bs = as.Date(mom_bs, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
         breast_milk = as.Date(breast_milk, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
write.csv(prenatal_biospecimens, "Z:/ECHO/CHARM/Data/Reports/2026/Prenatal Report/CSVs/prenatal_biospecimens.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
